title: Gradient engineering in interfacial evaporation for water, energy, and mineral harvesting
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05239K, Perspective
Lin Li, Xisheng Sun, Jie Miao, Haonan Wang, Yongchen Song, Dawei Tang
Various energy and mass gradients in solar-driven interfacial evaporation systems are decisive factors for energy and mineral resource harvesting. The guidance of gradient engineering promises to improve the water–energy–mineral supply chains.
